patternMatcherManualReview.description: Every intermediate leg runs with no minimum: router.exchange(..., _expected=0, ...) per yield token (L318), V4 swap exact-input with sqrtPriceLimitX96 = MAX_SQRT_PRICE-1 i.e. no price bound (L328-336), and sya.claim(nftIndex, 0, exempt) (L285). harvest() has no deadline parameter. Pattern conditions 'amountOutMin = 0' and 'no deadline' are met; 'user cannot specify minimum' is NOT met: the single aggregate minEthOut check (L249) is an atomic end-to-end bound, and the operator script sets minEthOut = max(simEthOut*(1-50bps), gas floor) and submits via a private relay (script/harvest.sh L12, L234-247, L255+). Sandwich value at risk is only the caller's own harvest profit; SYA's payment is fixed at par from skimSurplus and is not affected by the sale price, so no protocol/third-party value is exposed. Downgraded from pattern HIGH for that reason.
patternMatcherManualReview.verificationNeeded: Confirm harvest.sh minEthOut derivation is from the same fee-carrying simulation that will execute (bc math, SLIPPAGE_BPS bounds 0..10000), and that a stale/delayed private tx cannot execute against a materially worse state than minEthOut tolerates. Likely QA at most.
missingMitigations: contract accepts minEthOut=0 (direct callers/integrators bypassing harvest.sh rely on the gas floor only)

patternMatcherManualReview.description: ethOut = address(this).balance (L248) pays the WHOLE ETH balance to msg.sender, and surplus = IERC20(reward).balanceOf(address(this)) - owed (L291) swaps the WHOLE reward-token balance; the NFT refund returns the WHOLE balance of nftIndex (L242-244); _sellYield sells the WHOLE balance of each strategy token (L312). Matches 'contract balance paid out', 'recipient caller-chosen', 'payout not compared to contribution'. Also SELFDESTRUCT-FORCE-ETH (balance-dependent logic). Mitigating context: the contract is stateless between calls, receive() only accepts ETH from the PoolManager (L297-299), so any pot is stray value left by a third party (forced ETH, PoolManager.take donations, mistaken ERC20/ERC1155 transfers, V4 partial-fill leftovers if the price limit were ever reached). That is user-error value captured by the next caller, not an attack on honest users. Stray ETH can also make a gas-unprofitable harvest pass the Unprofitable check (benign). No rescue/sweep function exists, so mistakenly-sent assets are recoverable only by whoever harvests next.
patternMatcherManualReview.verificationNeeded: Confirm no path leaves an honest caller's value in the contract at the end of a successful harvest (V4 partial fill with sqrtPriceLimit MAX-1 should be unreachable; check hooks on the configured ethPool cannot return a delta that leaves reward/ETH behind). Expected QA/informational.
missingMitigations: no owner sweep for mistakenly-sent assets

patternMatcherManualReview.description: Balance-based branching in _sellYield (L312-315): for each non-exempt strategy token, a non-zero harvester balance with no registered route reverts RouteNotConfigured, and any non-zero balance is routed through Curve Router NG. An unprivileged griefer can donate 1 wei of a non-exempt strategy token (e.g. a token whose strategy delivered nothing this round, a token paused in SYA, or a registered strategy whose route the owner has not set) to force either RouteNotConfigured or a dust Curve exchange that may revert in some pool types (e.g. StableSwap-NG `dy = xp[j] - y - 1` underflow / ERC4626 zero-share deposit). Because the dust persists (no sweep), the DoS persists until a harvest sells it or the caller passes the strategy in exemptStrategies. Workaround exists (exempt the strategy; it had no yield anyway), and harvest.sh exempt list is manual, so impact is liveness/operator friction only. The DB pattern's spot-price conditions (critical spot-price decision, no TWAP) are NOT met: the harvester uses no price oracle and SYA prices claims at par from skimSurplus.
patternMatcherManualReview.verificationNeeded: Verify on a fork whether Curve Router NG / the registered mainnet pools revert on a 1-wei exchange for each MainnetRoutes route; if any does, the griefing is concrete (Low).
missingMitigations: no dust threshold / no skip on unrouted dust

patternMatcherManualReview.description: safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, nftIndex, bal, '') (L244) invokes msg.sender.onERC1155Received AFTER the unlock has produced the ETH and BEFORE ethOut = address(this).balance is read (L248) and paid (L254); harvest() has no nonReentrant. A re-entrant harvest from the hook would read and pay out the outer call's ETH. Conditions 'no reentrancy guard' and 'hook can re-enter' are met, but there is no victim: the hook runs only in the caller's own contract, the ETH in flight belongs to that same caller, the PoolManager unlock and SYA claim (nonReentrant) have already completed, and the harvester holds no other state. A nested unlock during the callback is impossible (AlreadyUnlocked). Inbound pull (L236) hits the harvester's own ERC1155Holder hook only.
patternMatcherManualReview.verificationNeeded: Confirm no stray third-party ETH can be present at L244 time beyond BATCH-PAYOUT case above; otherwise informational.
missingMitigations: no reentrancy guard (not needed given statelessness)
